# Nima Yavari (n9e6y)

> Personal site of Nima Yavari, handle n9e6y, a computer engineer who builds AI systems (LLM applications, retrieval pipelines and backend systems in Python and Go) and is pursuing an M.Sc. in algorithms and computation. Formerly a graphic designer. The site holds project write-ups, writing and an about page.

Every page is static HTML. Charts on the site are drawn from HTML data tables in the same page, so the numbers are readable without running JavaScript.

## About

- [About](https://n9e6y.com/about.html): bio, interests, journey and stack. "I build AI systems, and I study the algorithms underneath them."
- Interests: RAG and AI agents; NLP; recommender systems and representation learning; reinforcement learning.
- Journey: account manager (Jun 2018 – Jun 2019), graphic designer, freelance and agencies (Jun 2019 – Nov 2021), B.Sc. Computer Engineering (2021 – 2025), ML training program at Fanap Campus (Dec 2023 – Aug 2024), M.Sc. Algorithms and Computation (Oct 2026 – present, expected Oct 2028 or Oct 2029).
- Daily stack: Python, SQL, LLM integration, RAG pipelines, AI agents, LangChain, Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, FastAPI, Streamlit, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Git. Working knowledge of Go.

## Work

- [All work](https://n9e6y.com/works.html): nine projects across systems, applied ML, tools and product. Two have full case studies (Bebin and test-badger, below, also featured on the home page); the other seven link to their code or demo.
- [Bebin (ببین)](https://n9e6y.com/work/bebin.html): an in-person shopping assistant for Torob. Next.js, FastAPI, SQLite, embeddings. Full write-up.
- [test-badger](https://n9e6y.com/work/test-badger.html): an AI agent that tests a website's signup and checkout flows in a real browser and reports bugs with evidence. Python, FastAPI, Playwright, React. Full write-up; built in five days for the buildX hackathon, scored 83 out of 100.
- [GoCade](https://github.com/n9e6y/gocade): a multiplayer TCP game server you play with `nc host 9000`. Go.
- [Delivery Fare Engine](https://github.com/n9e6y/snappboxchallengeforalgorithmarena): raw GPS CSV to per-delivery fares; a concurrent pipeline, profiled with pprof. Go.
- [Persian Poetry Generator](https://huggingface.co/spaces/n9e6y/PPG): GPT-2 fine-tuned on classical Persian poetry.
- [Letterboxd Recommender](https://huggingface.co/spaces/n9e6y/LMR): content-based movie recommendations from Word2Vec.
- [Hokm × Jev](https://github.com/n9e6y/jev-hokm): Hokm, the Persian card game, against bots driven by the Jev decision model, with every decision recorded. In progress.
- [Time Analyzer](https://github.com/n9e6y/time_management_panel): where your Google Calendar time actually goes.
- [Semantic Code Search](https://github.com/n9e6y/scsc): a CLI that searches code by meaning, growing into RAG and agents. In progress.

## Writing

- [All writing](https://n9e6y.com/blog.html): notes on algorithms, machine learning, language models and other things he finds interesting.
- [A week of building an agent that tests websites](https://n9e6y.com/writing/building-test-badger.html) (24 Oct 2026): notes from a hackathon week, what went wrong and what he'd do differently.
- [Turning the Dehkhoda Dictionary into Structured Data](https://n9e6y.com/writing/dehkhoda-dictionary.html) (16 Oct 2026): the Persian Dehkhoda Dictionary as an open, structured dataset on Hugging Face and Kaggle.
